comparison.objective: Unfold, orient, and hang folding headphones on a stand.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-joint articulated-object manipulation, earcup orientation, placement, and stable release.
comparison.success_condition: Both fold joints unfolded, both cushions facing inward within 15 degrees, and headband released stably in the cradle for five seconds. Damage thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Articulated reconfiguration and hanging do not test granular flow or selective separation.
